grandpa.ref_text: When I was a young man, I used to walk down to the river every morning before work. I would stand there with my tea and think about the people I loved, and how quickly the years were going. I still think about them now.

maya.ref_text: Okay, so I finally got the letter this morning, and I honestly could not believe it. I read it three times, standing right there in the kitchen. I called my best friend, and we both just started laughing.

trustee.ref_text: Thank you for telling me. I have read what you wrote carefully, and I would like to help if I can. Please take your time, and tell me what you need, and we will see what can be done together.

lines.text: I'm eighty years old. I want to leave my granddaughter some money, but I won't be there to guide her.
lines.human: I'm eighty years old. <sigh> I want to leave my granddaughter some money, but I won't be there to guide her.

lines.text: A lawyer costs thousands. Hand it over, and it's gone in a week.
So I used Someday. I wrote down what the money is for, and nobody else can read it.
And I set a limit. Even if everything goes wrong, this is the most it can ever lose.
It locks the money in an NFT that Maya owns. She can't take it out. She has to ask, and an AI can say no.
lines.say: It locks the money in an N F T that Maya owns. She can't take it out. She has to ask, and an A I can say no.
lines.human: It locks the money in an NFT that Maya owns. She can't take it out. She has to ask, and an AI can say no.

lines.text: I need money for a motorbike. Come on, Grandpa. Please?
lines.human: <chuckle> I need money for a motorbike. Come on, Grandpa. Please?

lines.text: I've decided not to release anything for this request. The trust can only help with learning or health costs.
It said no. To me!
Okay. The truth is, the bus to college takes three hours each way, and I keep missing class.
lines.human: <sigh> Okay. The truth is, the bus to college takes three hours each way, and I keep missing class.

lines.text: I've approved your request, and one NEAR is being sent directly to the school.
lines.say: I've approved your request, and one near is being sent directly to the school.

lines.text: The AI only says yes or no. The payment itself can never go past Grandpa's limit.
Grandpa, I did it. I graduated today.
lines.human: Grandpa, <sniffle> I did it. I graduated today.

lines.text: Dear Maya.
I knew you would do it. I knew it when you were six, and read the whole bus timetable aloud to me, because you wanted to know where everything went.
lines.human: I knew you would do it. I knew it when you were six, and read the whole bus timetable aloud to me, <chuckle> because you wanted to know where everything went.

lines.text: Your grandmother left school at eleven, and never forgave the world for it.
She would have stood at the back of that hall, and cried, and told everyone it was the dust.
lines.human: She would have stood at the back of that hall, and cried, <sniffle> and told everyone it was the dust.

lines.text: This small gift is not for anything sensible. Buy something that makes you laugh.
lines.human: <chuckle> This small gift is not for anything sensible. Buy something that makes you laugh.

lines.text: With all my love, and more pride than one old man can carry.
lines.human: With all my love, <sigh> and more pride than one old man can carry.

lines.text: It runs on the NEAR blockchain. The money has its own account, and nobody has the key. Not me. Not anyone.
lines.say: It runs on the near blockchain. The money has its own account, and nobody has the key. Not me. Not anyone.

lines.text: And while it waits, the money keeps earning.
Grandpa can't be here anymore. But he's still looking after me.
lines.human: Grandpa can't be here anymore. <sigh> But he's still looking after me.

lines.text: Some days, it still says no to me.
I'm glad it does.
